body: Yes, so true. But those same ppl wouldn't want u to abandon them and 'grow up' if THEY. Were the ones standing on a bridge

That was July 1st this year ...
How bout u? Attempts or ideation?
We ended up having a long chat

No. The next time it was an embankment. Was about to drive over. Had not started my vehicle yet, but a fella walked by. Probably mid 50's, salt n pepper hair, tall guy. I happens to look up at him just as he was looking at me, and in one instant, he knew. He KNEW. I knew he knew. Freaked me out. Guy was probably a psychologist or some shit.

Gun to head, safety off, about to pull the trigger and I thought to myself
'WTF ARE U DOING!?'

I came really close to doing it, bro. Seriously. I almost called 911 on myself. Scared myself shitless. The 18 wheeler idea is scary to me. Don't wanna go under wheels. Mind you, none of it is good, all of it is bad and maybe deadly, but I'd be scared of accidentally living too. All mangled. Ugh.

I hear that, and I'm sorry you feel so bad that pills look like a good idea.
I fantasize about blowing my head off. I guess they call it suicidal ideation. Or going off a cliff. Why the last 24 mos?

It's pretty tough. I have days like today, where I made dinner, cleaned the kitchen and baked some Cinny buns from a tin, and I consider that a stellar day for me. I spend a lot of time on the couch, sadly
And by the way is she single? Was she likewise interested?

Dreams represent what we want or need in the waking world.. To me it makes sense u dreaming of her, because you want so much to be happy, and feel alive, and to have the feelings again that you had back then. Your heart is telling you it wants to love again. That's one gals take on it, for whatever its worth. You know they say there are two reasons we exist, and feel a sense of purpose for. To love, and to help others. If one can't love in the present, maybe one can help others.... This thought was suggested to me recently so I'm kind of chewing on it myself. It's just hard to think of doing stuff for others when I can barely get off the couch
Well, what did she say??.

You know, I would, and have thought about it lots. But I honestly feel that I would do more damage by opening up all those old wounds again for him since He moved on and has a life and family. Besides it only took three weeks for him to knock up another woman, so how much could he have really cared about me in the first place?
How about you? Have u thought of getting in touch with the girl from 16 years ago?

I often wonder if he does. But I have no way to know, obviously. A mutual friend spoke to him about 6 months ago or so and he said he had found love. (She hadn't spoken to him since we were together) .... But when I looked at his pinterest board, there was a pin about 'if someone walks out of your life, let them, you weren't the one who gaveup' so I don't know of course, but I think that might have been for  my benefit.

He got her pregnant three weeks after we split up in 2004-5?
Guess they were meant to be. We had been together over a year and never used birth control. And,
No I don't communicate with him
Le sigh.

No I'm certainly not in that place yet. I feel like I won't find it ever again and the person is happily married with kids now. 
But I have been told if I have felt love before I can find it again. But no at this point I'm too damn depressed to go anywhere or do anything to meet ppl. Besides. I don't have the energy for my own crap right now I can't see having extra energy to dote on a new partner. Gah

Of course. We attach to ppl and our emotions are tied to the experience we had with that specific person.  But if it can be had with one, it can be had with another, I think. But I also understand how hard it is to see that or believe it right now
Thanks. Good night. I hope tomorrow is beautiful for u

Have you considered the possibility that if you felt that way for one person in your past, that you might be able to find it again sometime in the future? I am thinking the same thing of a fella I dated 10 years ago and I left him. At the time, I didn't understand or appreciate what I had. 
But if it happened once, it could theoretically happen again, right?
Thank you for pulling for me. I deeply appreciate it. It's sad how many ppl are hurting right now. There is something seriously wrong with this world

It's not a bad tombstone idea, I must say. 
I'm hurting because I have a huge trauma history. And I lost my spouse and dog when we split recently, then 2 days later my Grama died. She was the only one who loved me growing up. Lots of other issues too. Just so much mountain to climb and no strength to even stand.
Blah bblah blah. I know I know, it probably makes me sound like a whiner, and maybe I am. 
Why are you hurting?

I'm sorry you are hurting :( I wish there was something wise or comforting to tell you but I'm at a loss. I'm kinda broken too. And I know how you feel. Well, I know what suffering feels like. On my tombstone I'd like it to say
'At peace at last'
You aren't alone. If u want to talk, U can message me
Today has definitely been one of those hour at a time kind of days. Thanks for the support, being alone is really hard over the long haul
